narrative: Broadcom's merely-solid quarter - beating but guiding Q3 AI revenue in-line and declining to raise the full-year outlook - repriced the entire accelerator-and-memory complex, sending the stock down about 15% and dragging Micron, Intel, AMD, and Nvidia lower across two sessions. That single custom-ASIC print resetting the whole group instantiates the expectations-asymmetry mechanism, where names priced for continuous beat-and-raise re-rate on anything short of it.
remaining_gap: Whether the next in-line print produces a sustained group re-rating with visible sell-side estimate cuts, not a transient drawdown.
